image_prompt: An antique Victorian steel engraving and 19th-century woodcut bookplate illustration in the style of deluxe 19th-century Longfellow poetry editions. A dramatic nocturnal scene on Boston Harbor under a luminous full moon: the British man-of-war HMS Somerset looms as a colossal phantom warship anchored in the bay, its rigging and masts silhouetted across the moon like prison bars, while two cloaked patriots in a small rowboat with muffled oars row silently across the tidal waters.
caption: The British man-of-war Somerset looming like a phantom prison across the moonlit bay, while patriots row with muffled oars toward Charlestown.
